entries.speaker: Melee Attacks
entries.en: During your turn, select a target and press[n][clr 2][f 1 10 23][clr 27] to perform a [clr 2]melee attack[clr 27] with[n]your currently equipped melee weapon.

entries.speaker: Melee Attacks
entries.en: Melee attacks are not particularly strong,[n]but they do not consume any HP or SP upon[n]use.
